title: Binary semaphore as a lock
description: sem_wait / sem_post around the critical section.

input.code:
# A binary semaphore (initial value 1) used as a lock.
shared counter = 0
semaphore s = 1

thread A
  WAIT s
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r
  SIGNAL s

thread B
  WAIT s
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r
  SIGNAL s
